propositions: rebar must not use git stash (push, pop, drop) in the tickets worktree because the stash stack is shared across all worktrees of a repository, allowing a stash created in one source worktree to be applied in the ticket store, corrupting it with non-ticket source files
a stashed entry popped into the tickets worktree left the index in an unmerged stranded state (DU entries with no MERGE_HEAD), blocking every subsequent ticket write until manual cleanup
the tickets worktree is a structural storage API and must be mutated only through rebar-provided entry points, never through direct git operations like stash, add, commit, or merge
git stash create + reset --hard + merge + stash apply <sha> replaces the stash-stack dance, using a named commit sha to guarantee the restore cannot apply another worktree's stash entry
a foreign path (source file not tracked on the tickets branch) that reaches the index via stash/merge must be auto-discarded and logged, healing the index without waiting for manual intervention

a supported maintenance entrypoint must exist with a backup ref created before any write, refusal when unpushed ticket commits exist, durable audit logging, and a break-glass override requiring an explicit written reason
